decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is use).

Condition : 3 - Within 2 months from the erection of the transformer unit, secure opaque 2m high fencing shall be placed around the unit so as to enclose it from view and maintained as such in perpetuity.

Condition : 4 - Within 1 month from the erection of the transformer unit, secure bicycle parking facilities shall be erected on site as shown on plan no. BFG0095.DWG. and maintained as such in perpetuity.
description: Resiting of bicycle shed and installation of transformer unit in car park.
